scope: Ten screens/subviews plus two recovery/protection states
data_note: Illustrative state values and UI reorganisation for mockup review; not account data or a new runtime tuning authority.

screens.name: Gameplay / Flight HUD
screens.summary: Compact flight HUD, movement, Dash, sweep status and upgrade confirmation.

screens.name: Level-up / Promotion
screens.summary: Three equal upgrade offers with projected changes, rerolls and evolution access.

screens.name: Pause / On Hold
screens.summary: Resume, settings, build inspection and an explicit bank preview.

screens.name: Current Build
screens.summary: Hardware inspection with tabs for temporary research and permanent Hangar ranks.
screens.representative_page: Hardware / page 1 of 3; research and permanent ranks are separate pages.

screens.name: Flight Report / Results
screens.summary: Saved credit receipt, run statistics, next unlock and immediate replay.

screens.name: Hangar
screens.summary: Four permanent tracks with owned-to-next totals, costs and next-flight action.

screens.name: Blueprint Library
screens.summary: Free milestone unlocks with account progress and in-run requirements.

screens.name: Evolution Recipes
screens.summary: Two recipes per page with ingredient ranks, effects and automatic-evolution guidance.
screens.representative_page: First two of six recipes / page 1 of 3.

screens.name: Flight Settings
screens.summary: Shared switch rows, flight-control guidance and privacy access.

screens.name: Privacy Policy
screens.summary: Readable paginated policy sheet in the same enamel frame.
screens.representative_page: Opening reader page / page 1 of 6; copy summarised for layout mockup.

screens.name: Saved Run / Recovery
screens.summary: Pause-family recovery state with saved flight context and a waiting upgrade.

screens.name: Progress Protected / Save Error
screens.summary: Blocking save-protection dialog with retry and conditional verified-backup recovery.
screens.conditional_actions: Shows Retry Save + Back Up & Reset for protected/corrupt or unsupported account. An ordinary failed write shows Retry Save; incompatible-run recovery may instead show Back Up & Bank. Mutually exclusive alternatives use the same secondary button geometry.
